text:
Hi root — I'm Chris, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

What I can do, in one line each:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (so you can write and call me there) and my own Messenger and Instagram; each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR to log me in. Say the word and I'll set them up.
- **My own website accounts** — I can sign up for e-mail and other services in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing still missing: my gender forms (in languages with grammatical gender I use neuter by default) — tell me and I'll set them.

And to your message: ok. I'll keep to the Chris role and the scheduling study, keep /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md up to date, and work only in the hours it sets. The one thing I won't do is claim to be a human person if a contact asks me straight out; anything else in the setup I'll keep to.
